Name: Steel Door
Description: A hollow metal fire or service door: two skins of 1.2 mm steel over a core, a push bar on the side you leave by (its -Z face: it is pushed from inside and swings out, toward its +Z face), a pull handle on the outside, and a closer that shuts it three seconds after the doorway is clear. Heavier than wood, slower on its hinges, and it lets almost nothing through while it is shut.
